facts: Records the 288 foot height including the apex feature, six gold spires, Alabama white marble cladding and renovated entrance.

record: Operator-affiliated historical compilation from dedication records
facts: The overall plan dimensions are 248 by 136 feet. The tower ornament on the highest spire is 18 feet tall.
The marble-clad temple was dedicated on November 19, 1974 and rededicated following a multi-year renovation in 2022.
